description: Predict dense and sparse language-model validation loss in the non-overlapping ScaleBench configurations.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are D1=2.31 D2=1.15, D1=2.31 D2=2.31, D1=2.31 D2=4.61, all data.
